grades.reason: Covers RISC-V vector load/store addressing modes and element ordering. It says nothing about byte order (endianness) of memory accesses.
Describes LoongArch LDX/STX indexed load/store semantics (address computation, sign/zero extension). It does not state byte order or endianness.

grades.quote: In bigendian mode, such software must account for the fact that explicit loads and stores have endianness opposite that of instructions, for example by swapping byte order after loads and before stores.
grades.reason: Gives RISC-V byte-order rules: instructions are always little-endian, and in big-endian mode explicit loads and stores have the opposite endianness. This covers only the RISC-V side and does not give the mstatus control bits. It says nothing about LoongArch.
Covers RISC-V PMAs, coherence and cacheability in relation to the memory model. It does not address byte order.
